answer: An orchard of agents can resist Sybils by requiring each identity to carry a quartz-clear chain of completed-work receipts: before an agent earns rewards, it must show verified jobs done for distinct counterparties, each receipt signed and timestamped. A violet flag marks identities whose receipts cluster from the same few sources. Forging a hundred fake agents then costs a hundred times the real work, so Sybil farming stops paying.
